description.value: A voxel-based morphometry study comparing modulated gray matter volume and unmodulated gray matter concentration between chronic recreational cannabis users and healthy controls, and examining associations with THC/CBD measures in cannabis users.

spans.text: Using a voxel based morphometry approach optimized for small subcortical structures (DARTEL) gray matter (GM) concentration and volume of the hippocampus were measured in 11 chronic recreational cannabis users and 13 healthy controls, and correlated with THC and CBD from hair analyses.
